findings.title: Insecure Transport in 127.0.0.1:5000:0
findings.description: Site is served over plain HTTP. All traffic including credentials and session tokens is transmitted in cleartext.
findings.llm_explanation: The site is served over unencrypted HTTP, exposing all traffic to interception. Found in 127.0.0.1:5000. Site is served over plain HTTP.
findings.fix_suggestion: Enable HTTPS with a valid TLS certificate (e.g. via Let's Encrypt). Redirect all HTTP traffic to HTTPS. Add the HSTS header.
findings.business_impact: All data transmitted to user session data — including passwords and session tokens — can be intercepted on the network.
findings.attack_path: UNKNOWN: deterministic fallback has no runtime proof.
findings.next_test: Run one authorized, read-only validation test and stop if it changes state or exposes real data.

findings.title: Clickjacking in 127.0.0.1:5000:0
findings.description: Missing X-Frame-Options header. The site may be vulnerable to clickjacking attacks where it is embedded in a malicious iframe.
findings.llm_explanation: The page can be embedded in an iframe, allowing attackers to overlay invisible controls and trick users into clicking. Found in 127.0.0.1:5000. Missing X-Frame-Options header.
findings.fix_suggestion: Add X-Frame-Options: DENY header or use Content-Security-Policy with frame-ancestors 'self'.
findings.business_impact: Users could be tricked into performing unintended actions on your application such as changing settings or transferring funds.
findings.attack_path: UNKNOWN: deterministic fallback has no runtime proof.
findings.next_test: Run one authorized, read-only validation test and stop if it changes state or exposes real data.
